name: Permission Scope Enforcement
description: Enforces machine-readable permission boundaries per agent. Every action evaluated against declared scope.
threat_addressed: Agents exceeding authorized scope can access unauthorized data and tools, leading to data breaches and compliance violations.
enforcement_mechanism: Machine-readable scope definition per agent. Per-action evaluation against scope using security.tools.allowed, security.tools.blocked, and security.scope configuration. Out-of-scope actions are blocked (enforce) or flagged (audit).
display_detail: Enforces permission boundaries for each agent action. Checks tool allowlists, rate limits, and destination restrictions.
remediation_hint_template: Action exceeded declared permission scope. Review security.tools and security.scope in ancilis.yaml. To allow this tool, add it to security.tools.allowed.
